ja.title: モスネツズマブの公開PopPKモデルを再実装する：段階的増量の曝露比較とRO–CRS外挿の限界
ja.summary: 公開論文と補足資料からmosunetuzumabのPKを再計算。仮想患者2,000例のpaired解析で投与量・間隔の影響を調べ、CD20占有率とCRSに翻訳できる範囲を検討する。図表・Pythonコード・CSV付き。

english.title: Reimplementing a published mosunetuzumab population PK model: step-up dosing exposure and the limits of extrapolating to receptor occupancy and CRS
english.summary: Mosunetuzumab PK recalculated from the published paper and its supplement. A paired analysis of 2,000 virtual patients examines the effects of dose and interval and how far exposure can be translated to CD20 occupancy and CRS. Figures, Python code and CSV files included.
